'''Tabetha's Farm'''{{co|45|57|Dustwallow Marsh}} is a small shack with a garden located in the murkiest part of [[the Quagmire]] in [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. [[Tabetha]] herself is present in the building, along with her two apprentices, [[Apprentice Garion|Garion]] and [[Apprentice Morlann|Morlann]]. She also has a dock to host those who navigate the waters of the swamp by riverboat. [[Andello Porter]] of [[SI:7]] can be found here.
